_comment: 全78カットの鉛筆パネル生成プロンプト。storyboard.json の各カットに1:1対応。suffix は全件に後置する。ref は参照に渡すCOREまたは既存ジョブ（人物の造形を保つため）。生成済みは generated.json の sb_* を参照。
suffix: Rough hand-drawn animation storyboard panel, graphite pencil on off-white paper, loose gestural construction lines, visible eraser smudges, cross-hatching for shadow, monochrome grey graphite only, no color, deliberately sketchy and unfinished, wide cinematic storyboard framing. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no watermark.

2.prompt: A row of seven old mail slots set into a wall, all of them coated in dust and cobwebs, one slot hanging slightly open. Straight-on flat composition.

4.prompt: Close-up of an old elevator floor-indicator panel above a lift door — an arched brass housing with a horizontal row of seven small round lamps. Five lamps are lit with small pencil burst lines; the second and sixth lamps are conspicuously dark and drawn as empty circles. Slightly low angle.

5.prompt: A long dim corridor with seven identical office doors receding in one-point perspective, every single door firmly shut. No people at all. Heavy hatching along the ceiling.

6.prompt: Almost the entire frame left as bare untouched paper filled with faint drifting fog scribble, with the merest suggestion of a crooked tall building silhouette at the lower right. A wide empty area in the upper middle reserved for a title card.

7.prompt: A single envelope sliding across the surface of a worn wooden desk into frame, seen from a low angle at desk level. Papers and a mug pushed aside at the edges.

9.prompt: Two hands holding an envelope upside down and shaking it hard, motion arrows and small shake lines around it. Nothing falls out — the space below the envelope is left as completely bare paper.

10.prompt: A storyboard panel divided by ruled pencil lines into seven small equal boxes in a grid. In every single box, the same simplified action is drawn from the same angle: a hand dropping a sheet of paper into a wastebasket. Seven near-identical repetitions, only the desk clutter differing slightly.

11.prompt: A wastebasket standing empty beside a desk, and on the desk above it the same single sheet of paper lying flat again. A thin pencil arrow curving from the basket back up to the desk. Morning light hatched across the desktop.

13.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (small girl, long black spiky hair sweeping to one side, high-collar jacket, layered skirt, striped tights, boots). Content: she has just set a lunch box down on an office desk and is turning away, but her head is snapped back over her shoulder, eyes locked on a sheet of paper on the desk. One boot already lifted mid-step. A small pencil arrow marks her stopped foot.

14.prompt: Close-up of two small hands fanning out seven sheets of identical business-form paper like a hand of cards. The ruled areas are left blank. Slight top-down angle over a stairwell step.

16.prompt: A corridor of seven office doors, three of them now cracked open a hand's width, with a partial face peering out of each gap — an old woman low down, a broad boxy silhouette, a very tall narrow head high up. The other doors still shut. Dim, hatched.

18.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (tiny old woman, small oval pale blank face, floor-length tattered black robe pooling on the ground). Content: she stands at a rooftop whiteboard with a marker raised, having just written a vertical list of agenda items — render the list as illegible pencil squiggle lines only. She half-turns to the table with complete composure.

19.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (slender figure, small oval blank pale face, straight black hair, pale coat hung with brass gauges). Content: tight close-up as she reads from a small notebook held at chest height without lifting her face, utterly flat and unbothered. Shallow depth, background left as bare paper.

20.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping it recognizable (very tall faceless figure in a pale canvas robe, head replaced by a small dark cylindrical apparatus with a spout, brass vessels at the chest). Content: it has just uncorked a tiny vial held up at arm's length; a violent burst of vapor sprays outward in radiating pencil lines while three other figures around the table recoil, hands to faces, papers flying up. Comic timing, strong motion arrows.

21.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (squat barrel-chested figure, pale domed head with two round goggle-eyes, gear-covered apron, mechanical claw hands). Content: seen from a low angle under a meeting table — he has opened a toolbox on his knees and is absorbed in assembling something, small gears rolling away across the floor. Above the table edge, other figures' torsos continue the meeting, unaware.

22.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (old printer whose torso is a cast-iron hand press with a flywheel, pale head with large round bulging eyes, beard of hanging paper strips). Content: he holds out a single freshly printed sheet at arm's length toward camera with total gravity. The sheet's contents left as blank paper with faint ruled bands.

24.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (small girl, long black spiky hair to one side, high-collar jacket, layered skirt, striped tights). Content: she sits squeezed into a chair at the end of a long meeting table, a notebook and pen pushed into her hands, looking up and to the side with wide startled eyes and her mouth slightly open. An empty lunch-box crate at her feet.

25.prompt: A rooftop meeting table seen from a high angle, its surface completely buried under scattered papers, loose gears, small glass vials and a toolbox. Seven pairs of arms reach in from all sides at once, overlapping and gesturing, drawn as a tangle of gestural lines. Two chairs shoved back at odd angles. Chaos rendered as line density.

26.prompt: A stairwell landing. Two mismatched figures pass each other going opposite directions — a tiny round old woman in a long black robe descending, a squat broad figure with mechanical arms ascending. Both have stopped mid-step and turned their heads toward each other. A narrow shaft of light between them. The pause is the subject.

27.prompt: Extreme close-up of an open notebook page on a knee, ruled lines drawn as blank bands with seven short illegible pencil scribbles listed one under another, each with a small tick beside it. A pen resting in the gutter. Warm hatching from a light off-frame.

28.prompt: A dim basement corridor seen from floor level. A cardboard box has tipped over and light bulbs have rolled across the concrete, one still spinning with small motion arcs. At the far edge of frame, only a pair of legs and one slack hand are visible on the floor, the rest of the body out of frame. Heavy shadow.

30.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (small girl, long black spiky hair to one side, high-collar jacket, striped tights). Content: seen over an old man's shoulder from the bedside — she leans in hard, both hands thrusting a sheet of paper forward into frame, brows down, insistent. Shallow focus, the bed and blanket hatched in the foreground.

33.prompt: Extreme close-up of a single small cut-out paper patch held between two fingertips, its torn edges lit from behind so the paper fibers show. Behind and softly out of focus, several ghostly overlapping hands are sketched very faintly in the act of writing and crumpling paper — drawn much lighter than the foreground, like a memory bleeding through.

34.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (very tall thin old caretaker, small elongated bald head with wrapped bandage-like surface). Content: close on his head and shoulders lying back on a pillow, eyes turned up toward the ceiling, mouth just parted as if mid-sentence. A bare bulb hangs above, its light drawn as radiating pencil lines. Quiet, still, the longest hold in the film.

35.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (small girl, long black spiky hair to one side, high-collar jacket, striped tights, boots). Content: exactly the same low-angle stairwell composition as an earlier running shot — she charges up the stairs gripping the handrail, but this time her mouth is shut hard and her brows are set. Motion arrows and speed lines. Same framing, different face.

36.prompt: A corridor of seven office doors, all seven now swinging open from the inside at once, drawn with arcing motion lines on each door. Light spills from every doorway across the corridor floor in hatched bands. No people yet.

38.prompt: Extreme close-up of an open logbook page, its ruled columns drawn as empty bands, with one short row of illegible pencil marks freshly added in the margin and circled twice. A pencil tip still touching the paper. Strong shadow in the binding gutter.

39.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (tiny old woman, small oval pale blank face, floor-length black robe). Content: a group of figures around a table all lean back with folded arms and doubtful postures — while she alone leans forward with both hands flat on the table, radiating delight, small burst lines around her head. The contrast between her and everyone else is the composition.

40.prompt: Close-up top-down of a document on a table with seven different company seals being pressed onto it one after another, drawn as seven small round stamped rings in a row with a hand bringing down the last one. Small impact lines at the point of contact. The document's text left blank.

41.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (slender figure, oval blank pale face, straight black hair, pale coat hung with brass gauges). Content: she stands facing a large wall-mounted clock, one hand raised flat as if about to give a signal, the other holding a written cue sheet. The clock face drawn without numerals, only tick marks and two hands. Tense stillness.

44.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (squat barrel figure, pale domed head with round goggle-eyes, gear-covered apron, mechanical claw hands). Content: he crouches beside a large wheeled mechanical chair he is building, fitting a big brass gear into its side with both claw hands. The chair's seat is drawn mid-rotation with a curved motion arrow showing it turning. Workshop clutter hatched behind.

45.prompt: Extreme close-up of a ledger spread on a desk under a low lamp, its columns drawn as empty ruled bands. A long thin hand with a pen rules a fresh line across two columns, joining them. Several older crossed-out lines above. Deep shadow at the page edges.

46.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (tiny old woman, oval pale blank face, floor-length black robe, small bell at collar). Content: she stands at a small desk writing a vertical order-of-ceremony on a long narrow sheet, rendered as illegible pencil marks. Her posture is upright and professional. A single white chrysanthemum in a jar beside her.

47.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (small girl, long black spiky hair to one side, apron over high-collar jacket). Content: high angle looking down at a kitchen counter where she is laying out plates in a row, counting them with a pointed finger, lips moving. Nine plates. Steam wisps from a pot at the frame edge.

48.prompt: A tall narrow spiral stairwell seen straight up from the bottom, with many mismatched figures on it at once at every level — some ascending, some descending, some pausing to hand objects across the rail to each other. Boxes, rolls of paper and tools being passed between hands. Busy, full of life, the exact opposite of an earlier empty version of this same shot.

49.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (very tall razor-thin man, block-shaped pale head with black flame hair, stitched line mouth, long slate overcoat). Content: he sits across a low reception table from a heavyset stranger in a plain modern business suit. Between them on the table are a rolled architectural drawing partly unfurled and a document with a pen laid across it. His hand hovers above the pen without touching it. Cold flat lighting, blinds hatched behind.

50.prompt: Extreme close-up of a vertical slice of a doorway gap, and within it a single wide human eye looking through, the rest of the face in deep shadow. Heavy hatching on both sides of the gap so only the narrow bright strip and the eye read clearly.

51.prompt: Low angle at floor level: a small notebook has fallen open and loose pages have scattered across a wooden floor, each page covered in illegible pencil scribble and small columns of marks. A shoe at the frame edge stepping back away from them. Papers drawn with light curl and motion lines as if just dropped.

52.prompt: A corridor of seven office doors, all seven caught mid-swing in the act of closing, drawn with arcing motion lines converging inward and small impact bursts at two of the frames. The light spilling from each doorway is being pinched into narrowing wedges on the floor. Exactly the reverse of an earlier all-doors-opening shot.

53.prompt: Extreme close-up of a logbook page where a line of marks has been vigorously erased — render the erasure as a scrubbed grey smear with eraser crumbs on the paper — and a new short mark written beside it. A pencil gripped hard, its point pressing a dent into the page. Cold flat light.

54.prompt: A rooftop at dusk, empty of people. In the middle of the bare concrete stands a half-finished wheeled mechanical chair, its side panel off and gears exposed, a wrench left on the seat. Fog has crept back in over the parapet and pools around its wheels. Wide, still, lonely composition with a lot of empty space.

55.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (very tall razor-thin man, block-shaped pale head with black flame hair, stitched line mouth, long slate overcoat). Content: he stands alone facing a window filled with flat white fog, seen from behind and slightly to the side so a sliver of his profile shows. His shoulders are dropped. His reflection is barely indicated in the glass. Very still.

57.prompt: Drawn VERY LIGHTLY as a faded memory — pale ghostly graphite, thin searching lines, large areas of bare paper. Content: the bottom of a stairwell seen from above at a steep angle. A toolbox lies burst open on the floor tiles with small gears scattered in an arc across the frame, and one work shoe lying on its side apart from the others. No body, no person. The emptiness where someone should be is the subject.

59.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (tiny old woman, oval pale blank face, floor-length black robe). Content: she has just set a large old ledger book down on a desk and is opening its cover with both hands, looking not at the book but steadily up at someone standing off-frame. The tall thin silhouette of that person is cropped at the edge of frame. Quiet weight.

61.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (block-shaped pale head with black flame hair, stitched line mouth, long slate overcoat). Content: tight framing on his hands and chest only, his face cropped out at the top of frame. Both hands have come down flat onto an open ledger page and gripped its edges hard, the paper buckling under his fingers. One of his fountain-pen-nib fingertips has torn a small nick in the page. No face, only hands.

62.prompt: A single sheet of paper being laid down onto a worn desk by a hand entering from frame edge — the exact same low desk-level composition as an earlier shot of an envelope arriving, but now the paper is a neat ledger sheet and the desk is tidy. Night: a desk lamp pool of light hatched around it, the rest of the room dark.

63.prompt: Close-up of an old elevator floor-indicator panel above a lift door, the second and sixth of its seven lamps still dark. In the foreground, out of focus and cropped, several mismatched figures are already turning away toward a stairwell door at the side. The dark lamps and the turning backs in the same frame.

65.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of an old wristwatch face on a wrist, drawn without any numerals — only tick marks, a minute hand, and a second hand caught a few ticks short of the top. Tiny scratches on the glass. Everything else in frame reduced to bare paper and a little cuff hatching.

68.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping it recognizable (very tall faceless figure in pale canvas robe, small dark cylindrical apparatus for a head with a spout, brass vessels at the chest, long thin dark hands). Content: it leans down and holds a tiny uncorked glass vial close to the face of a frail old man seated in a wheeled chair. A thin curl of scent rises between them, drawn as a delicate looping line. The old man's eyes are closed. Intimate two-shot, close framing.

69.prompt: A wheeled mechanical chair seen from above and behind, its seat rotating slowly — indicated with a broad curved motion arrow around it and small repeated ghost outlines of the chair back at three positions of the turn. A frail old man's hands have lifted off the armrests. In the background, arranged in an arc, seven doorways are each partly visible, as if being shown to him one by one.

70.prompt: Extreme close-up of a freshly printed broadsheet held up in two hands, still faintly ink-wet. Render the layout only — a large blank headline band across the top, two columns of illegible pencil scribble below, and a small blank date box. Ink shine indicated with a few white highlights left as bare paper.

71.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping him recognizable (very tall thin old caretaker, small elongated bald head with wrapped bandage-like surface). Content: framed on his hand and forearm only, lying on top of a blanket, the fingers just relaxing open from a loose curl. The rest of him out of focus behind. The bulb overhead has been switched off — the room is dark and only the hand catches a faint edge of light. Extremely quiet.

72.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (tiny old woman, oval pale blank face, floor-length tattered black robe, small bell at collar). Content: low angle from floor level as she rises to her feet in a darkened room, the hem of her long black robe swinging with the movement, drawn with a trailing motion line. Her small silhouette is made monumental by the low angle. Behind her, other seated figures' knees and hands.

73.prompt: An interior window seen straight on, its panes filled edge to edge with flat featureless white fog — render almost the whole rectangle as bare untouched paper. A worn wooden sill in the near foreground with a little dust hatching. Nothing else. Utterly ordinary, as if nothing had happened.

74.prompt: A long dim corridor with seven identical office doors receding in one-point perspective, every single door standing wide open and left that way, light from each doorway laid across the floor in overlapping hatched bands. No people. Exactly the same composition as an earlier all-doors-closed shot.

76.prompt: Top-down close-up of a single business form lying on a desk in a pool of lamp light. Along its lower edge, seven small round company seals have been stamped in a neat row — drawn as seven distinct stamped rings. The addressee band across the top is conspicuously left as pure bare paper. A pen laid beside it.

77.prompt: Redraw the character from the reference image as a rough pencil storyboard sketch, keeping her recognizable (small girl, long black spiky hair sweeping to one side, high-collar jacket, striped tights). Content: close over-the-shoulder view of her hand holding a pen and writing into the blank addressee band of a form on a desk — render her writing as a short illegible pencil mark only. Her face is partly visible past her shoulder, looking down, calm and certain. Lamp light hatched across the paper.
